3D Surface Plots

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/3d-surface-plots.Rmd
3d-surface-plots.Rmd

Basic 3D Surface Plot 

library(plotly.core)
# volcano is a numeric matrix that ships with R
go_figure() |>
  add_surface(z = ~volcano)

Surface Plot With Contours 

library(plotly.core)
# volcano is a numeric matrix that ships with R
go_figure() |>
  add_surface(
    z = ~volcano,
    contours = go_surface_contours(
      z = go_surface_contours_axis(
        show = TRUE,
        usecolormap = TRUE,
        highlightcolor = "#ff0000",
        project = go_project(z = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      camera = go_scene_camera(eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 1.87, y = 0.88, z = -0.64))
    )
  )

2D Kernel Density Estimation 

library(plotly.core)

kd <- with(MASS::geyser, MASS::kde2d(duration, waiting, n = 50))
go_figure() |>
  add_surface(x = kd$x, y = kd$y, z = kd$z)
Configure Surface Contour Levels

This example shows how to slice the surface graph on the desired position for each of x, y and z axis. contours.x.start (see go_surface_contours_axis()) sets the starting contour level value, end sets the end of it, and size sets the step between each contour level.

x <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
y <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
z <- rbind(
  c(0, 1, 0, 1, 0),
  c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1),
  c(0, 1, 0, 1, 0),
  c(1, 0, 1, 0, 1),
  c(0, 1, 0, 1, 0)
)

library(plotly.core)
go_figure() |>
  add_surface(
    contours = go_surface_contours(
      x = go_surface_contours_axis(
        show = TRUE,
        start = 1.5,
        end = 2,
        size = 0.04,
        color = "white"
      ),
      z = go_surface_contours_axis(show = TRUE, start = 0.5, end = 0.8, size = 0.05)
    ),
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    scene = go_scene(
      xaxis = go_scene_axis(nticks = 20),
      zaxis = go_scene_axis(nticks = 4),
      camera = go_scene_camera(eye = go_scene_camera_eye(x = 0, y = -1, z = 0.5)),
      aspectratio = go_scene_aspectratio(x = 0.9, y = 0.8, z = 0.2)
    )
  )

Multiple Surfaces 

library(plotly.core)

z <- c(
  c(8.83,8.89,8.81,8.87,8.9,8.87),
  c(8.89,8.94,8.85,8.94,8.96,8.92),
  c(8.84,8.9,8.82,8.92,8.93,8.91),
  c(8.79,8.85,8.79,8.9,8.94,8.92),
  c(8.79,8.88,8.81,8.9,8.95,8.92),
  c(8.8,8.82,8.78,8.91,8.94,8.92),
  c(8.75,8.78,8.77,8.91,8.95,8.92),
  c(8.8,8.8,8.77,8.91,8.95,8.94),
  c(8.74,8.81,8.76,8.93,8.98,8.99),
  c(8.89,8.99,8.92,9.1,9.13,9.11),
  c(8.97,8.97,8.91,9.09,9.11,9.11),
  c(9.04,9.08,9.05,9.25,9.28,9.27),
  c(9,9.01,9,9.2,9.23,9.2),
  c(8.99,8.99,8.98,9.18,9.2,9.19),
  c(8.93,8.97,8.97,9.18,9.2,9.18)
)
dim(z) <- c(15,6)
z2 <- z + 1
z3 <- z - 1

go_figure() |>
  add_surface(z = ~z, showscale = FALSE) |>
  add_surface(z = ~z2, opacity = 0.98, showscale = FALSE) |>
  add_surface(z = ~z3, opacity = 0.98, showscale = FALSE)
